description: Satellite & Terrestrial Link Budget. Runs server-side on rftools.io as an async job. Time budget 240 s. Returns a summarised result; ask for full for everything.

dataRate_bps.description: Data Rate (bps). e.g. 10e6 = 10 Mbps. min 1000, max 10000000000. omit for the default of 10000000

distance_km.description: Path Distance (km). GEO orbit ≈ 35786 km; LEO ≈ 500–2000 km; terrestrial path in km. min 0.1, max 50000. omit for the default of 35786

eirp_dbw.description: EIRP (dBW). min -10, max 90. omit for the default of 46

elevationAngle_deg.description: Elevation Angle (°). Satellite elevation angle from the earth station. Lower elevation = more atmosphere. min 5, max 90. omit for the default of 45. Applies when linkType is "satellite".

frequency_ghz.description: Frequency (GHz). e.g. 4 = C-band, 12 = Ku-band, 20 = Ka-band, 60 = mmWave. min 0.1, max 100. omit for the default of 12

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

gt_db_k.description: G/T (dB/K). Receive antenna gain minus system noise temperature (dB/K). min -30, max 50. omit for the default of 0

latitude_deg.description: Site Latitude (°). North positive. Rain rate, rain height, cloud water and water vapour are read from the ITU-R climate maps at this point. min -90, max 90

linkType.description: Link Type. omit for the default of "satellite"

longitude_deg.description: Site Longitude (°). East positive, west negative (New York is −74.0). Required: the climate maps vary with longitude as much as latitude. min -180, max 180

modulation.description: Modulation. omit for the default of "qpsk"

polarization.description: Polarization. omit for the default of "horizontal"

reqEbN0_db.description: Required Eb/N₀ (dB). Required Eb/N₀ for target BER from modem spec sheet. min 0, max 30. omit for the default of 7

stationHeight_km.description: Station Height (optional) (km). Height above mean sea level. Leave blank to use the ITU-R P.1511 topographic height at the site. min 0, max 8

targetAvailability_pct.description: Target Availability (%). 99.5% = 43.8 h/yr outage; 99.9% = 8.8 h/yr; 99.99% = 0.88 h/yr. min 90, max 99.999. omit for the default of 99.5

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_sat_link_budget
title: Satellite & Terrestrial Link Budget
